# The Aldera

> The Aldera is a US dietary supplement brand (ISP Group LLC, Aventura, Florida) built on one rule: what's printed on the label is what's inside. Full honest doses, natural ingredients only, and every production batch tested by an independent ISO 17025 laboratory — the lab report is printed on every box as a QR code. Launching October 2026 on TikTok Shop and thealdera.com.
